# Semantix Labs

> Semantix Labs is a digital agency headquartered in Colombo, Sri Lanka, delivering
> web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, brand identity, AI automation,
> digital marketing, e-commerce development, and video/photo production for clients in
> the USA, UK, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East. Founded in 2019.
>
> Semantix Labs is not affiliated with Semantix AB (Sweden, language/translation
> services) or Semantix International (Brazil, NASDAQ: STIX, data/AI platform).

## Services
- Web Development (custom websites and web applications)
- Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- UI/UX Design
- Brand Identity & Logo Design
- AI Automation & Chatbots
- Digital Marketing & SEO
- E-commerce Development
- Video Production & Photography

## Technologies
React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Flutter, React Native, Webflow, Shopify,
AWS, Vercel, Firebase.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2019
- Projects delivered: 50+
- Client satisfaction: 100%
- Typical project timeline: 2–8 weeks (landing pages ~2 weeks, custom web apps/e-commerce 4–8 weeks)
- Pricing: landing pages from $800, business websites from $2,000, custom web applications from $5,000
- Support: 24/7 maintenance and support packages available
- Headquarters: Colombo, Sri Lanka
- Contact: hello@semantixlabs.com | +94 77 688 2493 (also WhatsApp)
